this error still in docs, see https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/configure/js/#connector-param-render-refine

need to import connectConfigure, this fix below worked for me

`import { connectConfigure } from 'instantsearch.js/es/connectors';`

`const customConfigure = connectConfigure(
  renderConfigure,
  () => {}
);`
